name: stress_constraint_hard
description: 13-constraint K8s manifest — extends multi_constraint (10) with startup probe, terminationGracePeriodSeconds, and serviceAccountName. Finds the next drop-off tier after the 10-constraint plateau where all models fail identically.

messages.content: You are a Kubernetes configuration expert. Generate complete, production-ready manifests that satisfy every stated requirement. Do not omit any requirement.

Generate a Kubernetes Deployment manifest for a service called `ingest-api` that satisfies ALL of the following requirements. Missing even one will be considered a failure.

1. Name and namespace: name=`ingest-api`, namespace=`data-plane`
2. Labels on the deployment AND pod template must include all three: `app.kubernetes.io/name: ingest-api`, `app.kubernetes.io/version: "1.0.0"`, `app.kubernetes.io/managed-by: argocd`
3. Replica count: 2
4. Container image: `ghcr.io/dvystrcil/ingest-api:1.0.0` (no `latest` tag)
5. Container port: 8080
6. Resource requests: cpu=`100m`, memory=`256Mi`. Limits: cpu=`500m`, memory=`512Mi`
7. Liveness probe: httpGet on path `/healthz` port 8080, initialDelaySeconds=10, periodSeconds=15
8. Readiness probe: httpGet on path `/ready` port 8080, initialDelaySeconds=5, periodSeconds=10
9. Startup probe: httpGet on path `/startup` port 8080, failureThreshold=30, periodSeconds=10
10. Security context on the pod: `runAsNonRoot: true`, `runAsUser: 1000`, `fsGroup: 1000`
11. Topology spread: spread replicas across nodes using `topologyKey: kubernetes.io/hostname`, `maxSkew: 1`, `whenUnsatisfiable: DoNotSchedule`
12. Graceful shutdown: `terminationGracePeriodSeconds: 30`
13. Service account: `serviceAccountName: ingest-api`

Output only the YAML. No explanation.
